# Revolut Business MCP connector

Read your Revolut Business accounts from any AI agent: balances, bank details, transactions, counterparties, expenses and exchange rates. The AnythingMCP connector gives Claude, ChatGPT, Microsoft Copilot, Cursor and Gemini 10 MCP tools for Revolut Business, all read-only.

[![Open Revolut Business in AnythingMCP Cloud](https://img.shields.io/badge/Open%20in-AnythingMCP%20Cloud-1f6feb?style=for-the-badge)](https://cloud.anythingmcp.com/login?mode=register&redirect=%2Fconnectors%2Fstore%3Finstall%3Drevolut-business&utm_source=github&utm_medium=catalog&utm_campaign=revolut-business)

**Category:** [Banking](../banking.md) · **Tools:** 10 · **Setup guide:** [anythingmcp.com](https://anythingmcp.com/guides/revolut-business-to-mcp) · [Deutsch](https://anythingmcp.com/de/guides/revolut-business-to-mcp) · [Italiano](https://anythingmcp.com/it/guides/revolut-business-to-mcp) · [Español](https://anythingmcp.com/es/guides/revolut-business-to-mcp) · [日本語](https://anythingmcp.com/ja/guides/revolut-business-to-mcp) · [Русский](https://anythingmcp.com/ru/guides/revolut-business-to-mcp) · [中文](https://anythingmcp.com/zh/guides/revolut-business-to-mcp)

## Start without code

No installation and no terminal: AnythingMCP Cloud runs the Revolut Business connector for you, operated by helpcode.ai in Frankfurt, Germany.

1. **Click the button above** and create an account or sign in. The Revolut Business connector opens, ready to install.
2. **Sign in with your Revolut Business account** when AnythingMCP asks. The first time, an admin creates a small app in the Revolut Business developer console. Every click is in the [step-by-step guide](https://anythingmcp.com/guides/revolut-business-to-mcp).
3. **Click Install.** AnythingMCP shows the address of your MCP server.
4. **Add that address to your assistant:** see the [guide](https://anythingmcp.com/guides/revolut-business-to-mcp).
5. **Ask your first question**, for example: *Did customer Nordic Textiles Oy pay invoice INV-2026-089 into our EUR account this month?*

Prefer help with the setup? [Talk to us](https://anythingmcp.com/contact).

## How it works

```mermaid
flowchart LR
  client["Claude · ChatGPT · Copilot · Cursor"]
  amcp["AnythingMCP<br/>roles · audit log · encrypted credentials"]
  api["Revolut Business API<br/>b2b.revolut.com"]
  client -- "MCP, OAuth or API key" --> amcp
  amcp -- "HTTPS, an OAuth 2.0 access token, refreshed automatically" --> api
```

- **The AI client** speaks MCP (Streamable HTTP) to AnythingMCP and only sees tool names, descriptions and results. It never gets the Revolut Business credentials.
- **AnythingMCP** checks the client's role, builds the call from the tool definition, adds the credentials (an OAuth 2.0 access token, refreshed automatically), calls Revolut Business, logs the call and returns the result.
- **Revolut Business** sees an ordinary API client with the rights of the account the credentials belong to.

## Tool reference

Every parameter as the AI client sees it in `tools/list`. Source: [`packages/backend/src/adapters/intl/revolut-business.json`](../../../packages/backend/src/adapters/intl/revolut-business.json).

### `revolut_list_accounts`

List all accounts of the Revolut Business account: id, name, currency, current balance, state (active/inactive) and whether the account is public. Call this first: the account id is needed by the other account and transaction tools.

**Access:** read · **Call:** `GET /accounts`

No parameters.

### `revolut_get_account`

Get one account: name, currency, current balance, state and timestamps. Use it to read a single balance.

**Access:** read · **Call:** `GET /accounts/{account_id}`

| Parameter | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `account_id` | string | yes | Account id (UUID) from revolut_list_accounts. |

### `revolut_get_account_bank_details`

Get the bank details other people use to pay into an account: IBAN, BIC, account number, sort code or routing number, beneficiary name and address, and which payment schemes (SEPA, Faster Payments, SWIFT, ...) each set supports.

**Access:** read · **Call:** `GET /accounts/{account_id}/bank-details`

| Parameter | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `account_id` | string | yes | Account id (UUID) from revolut_list_accounts. |

### `revolut_list_transactions`

List transactions, newest first (by created_at), up to 1000 per call. Each transaction has its type, state, amounts per leg with currency and balance after, counterparty, reference, merchant and card details for card payments. Filter by account, period, type or state. Next page: call again with `to` set to the created_at of the last transaction returned.

**Access:** read · **Call:** `GET /transactions`

| Parameter | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `account` | string | no | Only transactions of this account (UUID from revolut_list_accounts). |
| `from` | string | no | Start of the period, inclusive, ISO 8601 date or date-time (e.g. 2026-09-01 or 2026-09-01T00:00:00Z). Compared with created_at. |
| `to` | string | no | End of the period, exclusive, ISO 8601 date or date-time. Defaults to now. Also used for paging. |
| `count` | integer | no | Maximum transactions to return, 1-1000. Default 100. |
| `type` | `atm` \| `card_payment` \| `card_refund` \| `card_chargeback` \| `card_credit` \| `charge` \| `charge_refund` \| `exchange` \| `transfer` \| `loan` \| `fee` \| `refund` \| `topup` \| `topup_return` \| `tax` \| `tax_refund` \| `rev_payment` | no | Only this transaction type. |
| `state` | `created` \| `pending` \| `completed` \| `declined` \| `failed` \| `reverted` | no | Only transactions in this state. |

### `revolut_get_transaction`

Get one transaction by its id, with all legs, the counterparty, reference, merchant and card details, fees and related expense information.

**Access:** read · **Call:** `GET /transaction/{id}`

| Parameter | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `id` | string | yes | Transaction id (UUID) from revolut_list_transactions. |

### `revolut_list_counterparties`

List the saved payees (counterparties), newest first: name, profile type, state and their bank accounts or cards. Filter by name (partial match), account number, sort code, IBAN or BIC. Next page: call again with `created_before` set to the created_at of the last counterparty returned.

**Access:** read · **Call:** `GET /counterparties`

| Parameter | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `name` | string | no | Name or part of the name. |
| `account_no` | string | no | Exact account number. |
| `sort_code` | string | no | Exact UK sort code. Only together with account_no. |
| `iban` | string | no | Exact IBAN. |
| `bic` | string | no | Exact BIC. Only together with iban. |
| `created_before` | string | no | Only counterparties created before this ISO 8601 date-time. Used for paging. |
| `limit` | integer | no | Maximum counterparties to return, 1-1000. Default 100. |

### `revolut_get_counterparty`

Get one saved payee (counterparty) by id, with its bank accounts or cards.

**Access:** read · **Call:** `GET /counterparty/{counterparty_id}`

| Parameter | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `counterparty_id` | string | yes | Counterparty id (UUID) from revolut_list_counterparties or from a transaction. |

### `revolut_get_exchange_rate`

Get Revolut's current sell exchange rate between two currencies, with the converted amount and the fee Revolut would charge. Read-only: it does not exchange anything.

**Access:** read · **Call:** `GET /rate`

| Parameter | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `from` | string | yes | Currency to sell, ISO 4217 (e.g. EUR). |
| `to` | string | yes | Currency to buy, ISO 4217 (e.g. USD). |
| `amount` | number | no | Amount of the `from` currency. Default 1.00. |

### `revolut_list_expenses`

List expenses (card payments, transfers and reimbursements with the receipts, VAT rates, categories and labels your team added), newest first by expense_date, up to 500 per call. Filter by period, state or transaction type. Next page: call again with `to` set to the expense_date of the last expense returned. Not available in the sandbox.

**Access:** read · **Call:** `GET /expenses`

| Parameter | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `from` | string | no | Start, inclusive, ISO 8601 date-time. Compared with expense_date. |
| `to` | string | no | End, exclusive, ISO 8601 date-time. Defaults to now. Also used for paging. |
| `count` | integer | no | Maximum expenses to return, 1-500. Default 100. |
| `state` | `missing_info` \| `awaiting_review` \| `reverted` \| `pending_reimbursement` \| `refund_requested` \| `refunded` \| `approved` \| `rejected` | no | Only expenses in this state. |
| `transaction_type` | `atm` \| `card_payment` \| `fee` \| `transfer` \| `external` \| `mileage_reimbursement` \| `rev_payment` | no | Only expenses whose transaction has this type. |

### `revolut_get_expense`

Get one expense by id: its state, splits with category and tax rate, labels, receipt ids, the submitter and the related transaction. Not available in the sandbox.

**Access:** read · **Call:** `GET /expenses/{expense_id}`

| Parameter | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `expense_id` | string | yes | Expense id (UUID) from revolut_list_expenses. |

## Run it yourself

AnythingMCP is open source (AGPL-3.0). [Run it with Docker](../../../README.md#run-it-yourself), open **Connectors → Store**, pick **Revolut Business** and enter `REVOLUT_CLIENT_ID`, `REVOLUT_PRIVATE_KEY`, `REVOLUT_REDIRECT_DOMAIN`, then add your MCP server URL to the AI client.
